preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 4 and 5000.
The number of edges m must be between n and 3 times n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be three vertices a, b, c indicating the positions of the bees.
The output must be three vertices a, b, c indicating the new positions of the bees after each move.
The output must be three vertices a, b, c indicating the initial positions of the bees.

invariants.description: The number of edges must remain equal to m throughout the game.

invariants.expression: all(degree(v) <= 3 for v in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: The degree of any vertex must not exceed 3.
There must be a cycle of length not greater than 5 passing through each edge.
